stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Together, they showed that memory can live in more than one place.”?
options: Understanding nature often begins by learning that common names hide many different lives.
Freedom works better when it considers the people who must share the room.
Digital spaces can connect many voices, while physical spaces give grief a room.
A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.
